zh: 新增本地工单系统：每个任务在 `.debug/work/` 下拥有自己的目录、索引与临时文件，测量值随工单退役，关闭时整目录删除，孤儿目录与散落临时文件由 `npm run work -- gc` 清理。
en: Add a local work-order system: each task owns a directory, index entry and temporary files under `.debug/work/`, measurements retire with the order, closing deletes the directory, and `npm run work -- gc` clears orphaned directories and loose temporary files.
